import sys

def articulationPoints(V, adj):
    def dfs(at, parent, low, disc, visited, ap):
        children = 0
        visited[at] = True
        disc[at] = low[at] = time[0]
        time[0] += 1
        for to in adj[at]:
            if not visited[to]:
                children += 1
                dfs(to, at, low, disc, visited, ap)
                low[at] = min(low[at], low[to])
                if parent != -1 and low[to] >= disc[at]:
                    ap[at] = True
            elif to != parent:
                low[at] = min(low[at], disc[to])
        if parent == -1 and children > 1:
            ap[at] = True

    visited = [False] * V
    disc = [float('inf')] * V
    low = [float('inf')] * V
    ap = [False] * V
    time = [0]
    for i in range(V):
        if not visited[i]:
            dfs(i, -1, low, disc, visited, ap)
    result = [i for i in range(V) if ap[i]]
    return result if result else [-1]

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
V = int(input[0])
E = int(input[1])
adj = [[] for _ in range(V)]
index = 2
for _ in range(E):
    u = int(input[index])
    v = int(input[index + 1])
    adj[u].append(v)
    adj[v].append(u)
    index += 2
print(" ".join(map(str, articulationPoints(V, adj))))
